Index इंडेक्स

A measure that tracks a selected group of shares, such as NIFTY 50 or SENSEX.

हिंदी में: इंडेक्स

चुनी हुई कंपनियों के समूह की कीमत को मापने वाला पैमाना, जैसे NIFTY 50 या SENSEX।

How it is used in the lessons

Index-wide halts trigger at moves of 10%, 15% and 20% from the previous close.

From Market Rules & Investor Protection

Compare your portfolio with a benchmark that matches its mix, such as an index for the equity part, over several years.

From Investing & Wealth Building

Index funds and ETFs: copy an index such as NIFTY 50.
